edges: Roy Glenister and Dextry, along with naive Swedes, are dispossessed of their lands by Alexander McNamara.
Roy Glenister remains hopeful that Helen is not involved in the conspiracy against the miners.
Cherry Malotte saves Roy Glenister from losing his stake in the Midas.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Helen Chester's affections are torn between Roy Glenister and Alexander McNamara.
Alexander McNamara rules ruthlessly, running the mines himself.
Alexander McNamara is appointed receiver of all the most lucrative mining claims based on fraudulent disputes.
Helen Chester learns about the scheme being perpetrated by Alexander McNamara and others.
Helen Chester is the niece of Judge Arthur Chester.
